buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidders have to quote rates for supply and distribution of refreshment items for awareness program mes of implementation of senior citizen under for Atal Yavo Abhyuday Yojana (AYAY) at ICDS Project, Ran gat. 2. The tenders will have to bid for all the items and not in parts inclusive of all applicable taxes. 3. Quality and Food Safety: The caterer shall prepare and serve fresh, hygienic, and wholesome food in co mpliance with applicable FSSAI standards. Food shall be prepared using good-quality ingredients, and stale or previously cooked food shall not be served. 4. Timely Service: The caterer shall ensure timely preparation, delivery, and serving of food as per the sch edule communicated by the Department. Any delay without valid reasons may attract penalties as per the contract terms. 5. Menu and Quantity: The menu, portion size, and number of servings shall beas approved by the Depart ment. Any changes to the menu shall require prior written approval from the authorized officer. 6. Cleanliness and Staffing: The caterer shall deploy adequately trained staff in clean uniforms and maintai n proper hygiene during food preparation, transportation, serving, and cleaning. The catering area shall be cleaned and restored after the event without additional cost. 7. Compliance and Liability: The caterer shall possess all valid statutory registrations and licences required for catering services, including FSSAI registration/licence where applicable. The caterer shall be responsibl e for any food quality issues, foodborne illness, or non-compliance with applicable laws and shall indemnif y the Department against such claims. 9. As per required in every month supply order will be issued to the supplier to supply in the respective Aw areness programme Date/venue & time. 10. Necessary documents for the qualifying criteria: a) Scanned copy of FSSAI Registration. (Mandatory) b) Scanned copy of EMD other than MSME registered organizations. c) Scanned Copy UDYAM/MSME Certificate relevant category if registere d under MSME for the purpose of EMD exemption (Mandatory) d) PAN CARD & Aadhaar Card (Mandatory)
